AAVSO states that its hosted data may be used in publications when the current Data Usage Guidelines are followed.

AAVSO states that International Database observations are freely available to the community for research and publication subject to its current Data Usage Guidelines. Only public ADS bibliographic metadata is retained. CTAS does not download, mirror, or assert reuse rights for article full text; publisher and repository links retain their own access and reuse terms. Event association requires an exact retained transient name.

The adapter uses ESO's anonymous TAP service only and retains a reduced-product row only when obs_release_date is present and no later than the query time. Each retained row passed a mission-specific past-release check; XMM also required data_in_heasarc=Y and NICER required VALIDATED. No file bytes were downloaded.
Only observation and product rows explicitly marked PUBLIC are retained. Product bytes remain provider-hosted; this system stores metadata and official download links only.

Rubin alert packets are world-public with no proprietary period, and Fink documents its LSST Science Portal and REST API as real-time, public services requiring no login. Coordinate and first-detection proximity are not proof of source identity.
No unvalidated, non-public, or ambiguous scientific record was stored.

WISeREP's official help states that private data require a personal API key for scripted access. CTAS sends no credentials, requests public=yes explicitly, and accepts only rows independently marked public=1 from the anonymous public export.
